component.name: Converty
component.summary: Offline PDF toolbox: merge, split, compress, convert and sign

description.p: Converty is an offline, open-source PDF toolbox with a COSMIC look for Linux, Windows and macOS. It brings the tools you usually reach for in online PDF services to your desktop, and every file is processed locally: nothing is uploaded, nothing leaves your machine.

ul.li: Convert images, Office documents and HTML to PDF
Convert PDF to images, Office documents and PDF/A
Rotate pages, add page numbers, watermarks and crop
Sign, protect with a password and unlock PDF files
Convert videos between MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and AVI, or save their sound as audio

description.p: New video tools: convert videos between MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and AVI, and save the sound of a video as MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC or Opus. Needs FFmpeg.
First public release with merge, split, page tools, compression, conversion, watermarking, signing and password protection.
